citations.quote: prices are set equal to the specialists' conditional expectation of the asset's value given the type of trade that occurs
In this model the ask price exceeds the bid because the former is set in anticipation of receiving a buy order, the latter a sell order

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Risk-neutral competitive dealers post regret-free bid/ask quotes equal to the asset's conditional expected value given a sell or buy, so the spread is pure adverse-selection compensation and transaction prices form a martingale.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: The Glosten-Milgrom Sequential-Trade Model: Spread from Adverse Selection
